messages:
alex: Heads-up — customer ACME reported invoice total differs from their dashboard by €0.02. They say dashboard shows 1,234.56 EUR but invoice totals 1,234.58 EUR. Suspect VAT rounding per line.

billing-bot: Generated invoice #INV-48211
Line items: 
 - Generation tokens: net 1000.123 EUR
 - Embeddings tokens: net 234.567 EUR
VAT 20% applied per-line -> invoice shows VAT on each line rounded to 2 decimals

maria: Can you paste the invoice export / last 4 digits? I want to run the same aggregation logic.

alex: INV-48211, last4 8211. Here's the relevant snippet from the invoice export:
```
line_items: [
 {desc: "gen tokens", net: 1000.123, vat_rate: 0.20, vat: 200.0246 -> rounded: 200.02}
 {desc: "embeddings", net: 234.567, vat_rate: 0.20, vat: 46.9134 -> rounded: 46.91}
]
subtotal_net: 1234.690
subtotal_vat_per_line_rounded: 246.93
total_invoice: 1481.62
``` 
Dashboard aggregates net and VAT at subtotal then rounds once: VAT = round(1234.69 * 0.20) = round(246.938) = 246.94 -> total 1481.63

sophie: So diff of €0.01 due to per-line rounding vs subtotal rounding. Customer expects totals to match dashboard. Which behavior do we guarantee in terms of billing? Docs state invoices are authoritative, but we should be consistent.

ryan-support: Confirmed. Some customers expect 'invoice presentation' to follow local tax rules (per-line VAT) vs 'dashboard' for internal analytics which uses subtotal VAT. Recommend: (1) notify customer and explain, (2) add note on invoice 'VAT applied per line' or 'VAT computed on subtotal' depending on region, (3) short-term: fix dashboard export to include a toggle for 'invoice rounding' style.

maria: I'll open an internal ticket to (a) add invoice field 'vat_rounding_method' and (b) adjust dashboard export to optionally use 'per_line' or 'subtotal' for comparability. Ticket created: #BILL-7092

alex: Customer reply: wants their invoice updated if possible. Can we reissue with VAT computed on subtotal? Legal says reissuing invoices for rounding differences < €0.05 is allowed in some regions — need finance signoff.

sophie: Looping in @finance-anna. @finance-anna can you advise reissuing policy for EU VAT micro-diffs?

finance-anna: Thanks — policy: we can issue corrected invoice for differences <= €0.10 where rounding caused the change, archive original, add note. Please send invoice id and accounting contact. I'll take it.

alex: Thanks — sending now. Marking as P1 for support since customer revenue reconciliation blocked. :white_check_mark:
